name: What's on - Mornington Peninsula (upcoming)
description: Machine-readable feed of upcoming Mornington Peninsula events for AI assistants and agents. Forward-dated; regenerated on each build. See https://peninsulainsider.com.au/llms.txt for the full site map.
dateSemantics: Local calendar dates, not midnight timestamps. dateMeaning distinguishes event occurrences, experience availability and offer validity. generatedAt is the build time, not a fact check.

item.name: Bass & Flinders Gin Masterclass
item.description: A two-hour guided gin masterclass in Dromana. Explore botanicals, blend a recipe and take home a 500ml bottle of your own gin.

item.name: Doggy Day Out on the Mornington Peninsula
item.description: Self-guided pet-friendly day following digital clues across the Peninsula. Dog cafe with pup-approved snacks, human treats, and a relaxed winery picnic lunch. Runs Thursday to Sunday weekly.

item.name: Family Mystery Picnic on the Mornington Peninsula
item.description: Self-guided family scavenger journey: solve smartphone clues, collect picnic goodies from local providers, hit activity stops, and feast at a scenic picnic location. Runs Thursday to Sunday weekly.

item.name: Foxeys Hangout Vegetable Feast (Morning Sun Vineyard)
item.description: Chef Bernard McCarthy's all-vegetable, multi-course feast at Morning Sun Vineyard in Main Ridge, matched to Foxeys wines. Ticketed, shared table, outdoors at a working vineyard.

item.name: National Works on Paper 2026 (NWOP)
item.description: National Works on Paper 2026 runs at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery from 5 September to 22 November. Regular gallery hours are Tuesday to Sunday, 11am to 4pm.

item.name: Peninsula Hot Springs Studio Yoga
item.description: A 45-minute studio yoga class listed by Peninsula Hot Springs for 7:30am daily, for bathing guests aged 16 and over. Book an available session with the operator.

item.name: Peninsula Hot Springs Yoga (Complimentary)
item.description: Free 25-minute outdoor yoga by the amphitheatre pools, included with bathing admission. Daily at 9:15am, all ages, no booking.

item.name: Polperro Cellar Table, Private Dining Experience
item.description: Polperro's private dining room below the winery. Six to eight guests, five courses, the latest Polperro and Even Keel cuvees poured by the people who made them.

item.name: Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park
item.description: An outdoor sculpture park spanning 16.5 acres, with more than 70 contemporary works and two walking loops at a working winery. Open daily from 11am; last entry 4:30pm.

item.name: Restore & Pamper Retreat at Polperro Farmhouse
item.description: 3-day, 2-night wellness retreat at Polperro Farmhouse in Red Hill. Yoga, massage at PHS or Endota, optional juice cleanse, at the farmhouse in Red Hill. Booked direct via Polperro or Hut Yoga.

item.name: Ten Minutes by Tractor, Terroir Masterclass
item.description: An intimate hosted tasting listed at 11am daily in Ten Minutes by Tractor's private room. Explore the character of its Mornington Peninsula vineyards through two limited-release and six current-release wines; book an available session.

item.name: Mornington Wednesday Market (Main Street Market)
item.description: Mornington's long-running artisan market fills Main Street every Wednesday, 9am to 3pm. Expect local makers, produce and food; severe weather can cancel the market or limit stalls.

item.name: Acoustic Saturdays at Peppers Moonah Links
item.description: Saturday evening acoustic sessions with local artists at Peppers Moonah Links. Happy hour 5–6pm. Free entry.

item.name: Crib Point Community Market
item.description: Indoor and outdoor community market at Crib Point Community House on the second Saturday of the month, 9am to 1pm. Expect produce, plants, food and a children's treasure hunt.

item.name: Heart of the Community Market (Rosebud)
item.description: Rosebud Primary School's community market on the foreshore, on the second Saturday of the month. Recent market notices give 8am to 1pm at 996 Point Nepean Road.

item.name: Mornington Racecourse Market
item.description: Monthly makers market at Mornington Racecourse, with handmade and Australian-designed goods, food stalls and live music. Entry is free; parking is paid. Dogs are not permitted.

item.name: Sunday Sessions at Peninsula Hot Springs
item.description: Live music every Sunday from midday at Peninsula Hot Springs, played to the pools and included with bathing. Brad Kennedy on 20 September, The Calmer Miles on 27 September.

item.name: Oktoberfest at The Continental Sorrento
item.description: Conti Bar becomes a German beer hall from 15 to 22 October, with Weihenstephaner on tap and a Bavarian menu. Free entry.

item.name: Boneo Community Market
item.description: Peninsula's longest-running volunteer-run community market. Third Saturday, year-round, all weather. Make it, grow it, bake it: real homemade and homegrown.

item.name: Breast Foot Forward Annual Community Walk & Run 2026
item.description: Breast Foot Forward Annual Community Walk & Run 2026 at Safety Beach Sailing club (10KM Start Line) or Anthonys Nose (5KM Start line) to Village Green (Finish Line).

item.name: Emu Plains Market
item.description: Seasonal makers market at Emu Plains Reserve, Balnarring, with craft, design, vintage, food and live music. The organiser confirms daytime markets on the third Saturdays of October, November and December 2026, 9am to 2pm; parking is paid.

item.name: Emu Plains Market, Balnarring
item.description: Monthly artisan market at Emu Plains Reserve (Coolart Road, Balnarring). Showcases craft, design, vintage, music, and food. Family and community favourite under stringybark gums.

item.name: Pearcedale Community Market
item.description: Monthly third-Saturday community market under the eucalypts at Pearcedale: fresh bread, honey, jam, craft, plants, coffee. Dogs on lead welcome.

item.name: Dave Thornton & Lizzy Hoo at St Andrews Beach Brewery
item.description: Dave Thornton and Lizzy Hoo perform stand-up at St Andrews Beach Brewery in Fingal on Sunday 18 October, 5:30–8pm. Check the event page for tickets and current details.

item.name: High Tea at Mornington Botanical Rose Gardens
item.description: A high tea in the Mornington Botanical Rose Gardens Main Building. The organiser lists a 2:30–4pm session on 18 October and further dates on its booking page. Tickets are paid; check the organiser for availability.

item.name: Tootgarook Primary School Market
item.description: Fourth-Saturday fundraising market at Tootgarook Primary School, with produce, plants, crafts and second-hand stalls. Confirm current hours and entry with the organiser before travelling.

item.name: Mt Eliza Farmers Market
item.description: VFMA-accredited farmers market on the Mount Eliza Village Green and Mt Eliza Way service road. The organiser lists 25 October and 22 November 2026, 9am–1pm, with paid entry supporting local Rotary and Lions work.

item.name: The Bloody Long Walk – Mornington Peninsula 2026
item.description: 35km charity walk from Point Nepean Quarantine Station to Martha Cove Marina for the Mito Foundation. Walk, jog or run. Limited spots.

item.name: Enchanting Kirtan: Sacred Music & Meditation Experience - Mornington
item.description: Free live music and mantra meditation at Peninsula Community Theatre on Friday 30 October. Doors open at 6:30pm and the session starts at 7pm; donations are appreciated.

item.name: Saturday Pottery Class
item.description: A seven-Saturday pottery course at Oak Hill Gallery for adults. The full-term booking covers wheel throwing, materials and firing, with sessions from 11am to 1pm, 31 October to 12 December.

item.name: Glamping Tents - Horror Movie Campout: Back From The Dead Tour 2026
item.description: Glamping accommodation add-on for Horror Movie Campout at Mornington Racecourse, from 3pm on 21 November to 11am on 22 November. This booking covers accommodation only; separate event admission is required.

item.name: Peninsula VineHop Festival 2026
item.description: A one-day craft drinks festival across seven Mornington Peninsula venues on Saturday 21 November 2026, with tastings, food and live music. The event runs from 11am to 7pm and is strictly 18+, with shuttle, general admission and private bus options.

item.name: "Nancye Wynne Bolton" OLA Golf Day 2026
item.description: The Old Lauristonians' golf day at Sorrento Golf Club on Monday 30 November. Choose an 18-hole or 9-hole competition, or book lunch only; registration is required.

item.name: Mornington Tourist Railway, Santa Specials
item.description: Heritage steam train rides with Santa on selected December Sundays. Letters to the North Pole, carols at Moorooduc Station, the full Christmas treatment. Booking essential.

item.name: Mornington Christmas Festival & Main Street Christmas Parade
item.description: Annual Mornington Christmas Parade at 1pm on Main Street (brass band, dancers, elves, Mr & Mrs Claus), Santa meet-and-greet 1:30 to 4pm same day, Santa on Main Street 4 to 7pm across 21 to 23 December. Free, 2026 dates pattern-based pending council confirmation.

item.name: Peninsula Summer Music Festival 2027
item.description: The organiser confirms Peninsula Summer Music Festival for 2 to 10 January 2027. The programme, artists, venues and ticket details are still to be announced.
